## Checklist

- [ ] Each new `id` is unique, lowercase, and uses dashes (no spaces or capitals)
- [ ] `type` matches an existing key in `CATEGORIES` (or the category was added)
- [ ] Multi-line `text` uses backticks, with a blank line between stanzas
- [ ] Trailing commas and braces/brackets are balanced (page loads without a blank screen)
- [ ] Text accuracy checked against a reliable source
- [ ] Previewed locally (`python3 -m http.server`) — appears in the list, search, and correct language tabs
- [ ] Bumped `CACHE_VERSION` in `sw.js` if any file changed (so installed/offline devices refresh)
